data.long_meaning: The name Liorael is derived from the Hebrew language and means 'Light of God'. In Christian tradition, this name is often associated with the biblical figure of Elioras, who was a faithful servant of God. The name Liorael carries the meaning “Light of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Liorael usually hope their child will grow to embody light of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Liorael belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Liorael total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

historical_references.reference: Liorael is believed to be derived from the Hebrew words 'leor' meaning 'lion' and 'el' meaning 'God'. This name may have been adopted by early Christians as a symbol of divine strength and protection.
historical_references.context: During this period, early Christianity was spreading throughout the Mediterranean world, and many new converts were adopting names with Hebrew or Greek origins. The name Liorael may have been chosen by those seeking to express their faith through a name that evoked both the power of God and the strength of a lion.

In fantasy literature, Liorael can be found in numerous fictional works, often as a powerful sorceress or an ethereal being. Role-playing games, particularly those with a fantasy setting, also feature characters with this name. Overall, the name Liorael has become synonymous with light, magic, and the fantastical.
